'''Hovus Jorrick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who served as [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]].

==Biography==
Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Jorrick met Imperial envoy [[Jahan Cross]] who was asking the head of House Borgin, Lord [[Rodas Borgin]] to allow him to join the flight on the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] so he could protect [[Bron Dooku]]. Rodas said that Jorrick would be protecting the Count so to prove his point that he would be better at guarding the Count than the Klatooinian, Cross told Jorrick to shoot him. Jorrick did as instructed but before he could pull the trigger he was knocked down by Cross. Seeing this, Rodas replaced Jorrick with Cross and he did not accompany the cruse in the air ship.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 2" />

Jorrick was then placed in charge of security at [[Otoh Dooku]], protecting the young Count Dooku. Unfortunately, [[Candra Tymon]] and Cross took the boy, and escaped in [[Manta droid subfighter]]s. Jorrick and his security pursued them in their sub-fighters . However, Jorrick was misled and informed that a [[Bongo]] was moving away fast. Jorrick and remaining security forces then pursued the bongo. He was then contacted by Lord Borgin, and was ordered to fall back and wait till Cross, Tymon and the boy land, then he would get the boy back.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 4">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref>

Jorrick was able to do that. However, in addition to Cross and Tymon, he and his security force had to deal with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. A firefight started and Jorrick was wounded in the chest by Cross. Despite his wound, Jorrick pursued Cross and Fett to get the boy. Just as they were arriving, they saw Fett fire a missile which apparently destroyed [[Imperial Diplomatic Shuttle Nine-Nine-Three|Cross's shuttle]] and killed Tymon and the boy. He then informed Lord Borgin of this. However, unbeknownst to him the boy survived. At [[Borgin Castle/Legends|Borgin Castle]], Jorrick was left to die of his wounds by Lord Borgin.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hovus Jorrick first appeared in [[2012]], in the [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' series of comics. In that particular issue, Jorrick's species was misspelt as "Klahtooinian."
